newsitem.title: USA: Ill. cities to buy part of Fort Sheridan site.
newsitem.headline: Ill. cities to buy part of Fort Sheridan site.

text.p: Two suburbs north of Chicago agreed to pay the U.S. Army a base price of $5.75 million for the 140-acre Fort Sheridan Historic District, the mayors of the communities announced Wednesday.
Highland Park and Highwood city councils, and the Army, must still give final approval to the agreement reached Tuesday, a statement from the two communities said.
"We have agreed on a base price and valuation formula based upon adherance to the conceptual re-use plan approved by our communities in 1994," Highland Park Mayor Raymond Geraci said.
The cities have also agreed to pay incremental increases over the base price if the development of the property exceeds 551 units.

Another 290 acres of open space will be transferred to the Lake County Forest Preserve District and the development plan includes renovating and adapting more than 90 historic buildings as single family homes, condominiums and townhouses.
